answer: A concrete approach: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. An identity earns only when its tide recurs, its atlas survives audit, and a lotus from an unlinked peer confirms it.
